actions.action: Slide plant out of nursery pot and check roots
If roots are brown/mushy, trim them and repot into fresh dry cactus mix
Tip out standing water from the grey outer pot
Bottom-water in a bowl with 2 inches of water for 15 minutes when soil is fully dry, then drain
Snip off spent flower stalks at the base
Move plant within 2 feet of brightest window
Give the plant a quarter turn weekly

reason: The answer correctly identifies dry, water-repellent soil that can't rehydrate the plant; its bottom-watering step resembles the soak that worked but is shorter, delayed until the next dry-out and mixed in with other tasks, though nothing is likely to harm the plant.
